newsitem.title: GERMANY: German air cargo exports up 6.5pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: German air cargo exports up 6.5pct in 1996.

text.p: Air cargo exports from Germany grew 6.5 percent to 1,011,904 tonnes in 1996, the German airports association (ADV) said.
Frankfurt airport showed a 4.3 percent rise to 724,627 tonnes of flown export cargo last year, an ADV traffic report said.
Export cargo growth rose 15.1 percent to 157,234 tonnes at Cologne and 11.4 percent at Munich to 37,827 tonnes.
Duesseldorf, the three Berlin airports combined and Stuttgart also saw double-figure air cargo exports growth last year, the ADV said.. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
